+#!/bin/bash
+set -e
+
+API="https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/accelerators_accelerateurs-aws"
+
+fetch() {
+    local url="$1"
+    local outfile="$2"
+    local status
+    status=$(curl -s -L -o "$outfile" -w "%{http_code}" "$url")
+    if [ "$status" -ge 400 ]; then
+        echo "Retrying $url after 5s..."
+        sleep 5
+        status=$(curl -s -L -o "$outfile" -w "%{http_code}" "$url")
+    fi
+    echo "$status" > "${outfile}.status"
+}
+
+fetch "$API" /workspace/repo.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/" /workspace/root_contents.json
+sleep 1
+fetch "$API/contents/CONTRIBUTING.md" /workspace/contributing.json
+sleep 1

GC Accelerators (AWS)

AWS has developed a project called the AWS Secure Environment Accelerator (ASEA) with the goal to accelerate the GC’s Amazon Web Services (AWS) deployments. It can be found at: https://github.com/aws-samples/aws-secure-environment-accelerator and it has been open-sourced by AWS under the Apache-2.0 License.
